name: Agency Agents
summary: A collection of specialised AI agent definitions, each with its own domain focus, working style, process and expected deliverables. They can be installed into Claude Code and several other coding tools, either with an install script or by copying a category folder.
install_steps: Run ./scripts/install.sh --tool claude-code to install all agents into your Claude Code directory
Or copy only one division, for example: cp engineering/*.md ~/.claude/agents/
Optionally use the project's desktop app, which installs the agents into Claude Code and other supported tools
example_use_case: You want a specialist for frontend work rather than a generic prompt, so you copy the engineering agents into your Claude Code agents folder and call on one for that task.
